seo.seo_title: Live streaming of events and meetings | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: We live stream conferences, lectures, AGMs and events with multiple cameras, graphics and recording, to your website or social media.

page_header.t4: You run the programme. We bring the equipment and handle cameras, sound, graphics and streaming, so that everyone can take part wherever they are.
page_header.t7_alt: Audience at an event in Boden Business Park, with speakers on stage and a presentation on a large screen

vad_ingar.t11: You focus on the content and the audience. We bring the equipment, set up, test and stream.
vad_ingar.t13: Several camera angles, live vision mixing and clear sound from start to finish.
vad_ingar.t15: To your website, YouTube, Facebook or LinkedIn, all at once.
vad_ingar.t17: Name titles, logo and presentations right in the stream.
vad_ingar.t19: The whole stream is recorded, and we cut short clips for social media afterwards.

var_ska_ni_sanda.t30: Choose where your viewers are. We stream to all of them at once.

sa_gar_det_till.t40: Live streaming is quoted per event. You get a fixed price before we start.
sa_gar_det_till.t43: We go through the programme, venue, audience and where the stream will be shown. Then you get a quote with a fixed price.
sa_gar_det_till.t45: We visit the venue, or go through it remotely, and check the internet connection, power, lighting and where the cameras will stand.
sa_gar_det_till.t47: We arrive in good time, set up cameras and sound and test the whole chain, from microphone to viewer, before the stream starts.
sa_gar_det_till.t49: We run picture, sound and graphics throughout the stream, so you can focus on your guests.
sa_gar_det_till.t51: You get the recording and, if you like, short clips to share.
